name: SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 1

function.text: SMARCA1 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily A member 1. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding and helicase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
